original_prompt:
Create one full-body character master by extending the supplied APPROVED PORTRAIT into a head-to-toe view. Reference image is the absolute authority for identity, rendering style, skin, hair, material quality and lighting. It is a premium semi-realistic otome 2.5D/3D cinematic character render, not a live action photograph or painted illustration. Replicate its exact refined face sculpt, soft gentle adult eyes and eyebrows, gray-green irises, rose lips, soft innocent expression, luminous subtly textured skin, ash-blonde hair with very fine individually resolved strands and dimensional sheen. Carry the same portrait-quality rendering faithfully through every part of the full-body image; no vague airbrushed face, blurry hair masses, flat plastic skin, coarse texture, painterly strokes or generic game low-detail body.
Single adult woman age 26, frontal entire body including top of hair and boot soles, centered on a white seamless studio background. Tall slender natural model anatomy approximately 7.5 heads tall, NOT tiny head or gigantic head. Elegantly long legs without overstretching. Head is naturally balanced directly above ribcage, neck upright and unstrained, relaxed lowered shoulders and open collarbones. Comfortable ordinary frontal standing posture, relaxed elbows and hands at sides with soft fingers. Feet uncrossed, a small comfortable gap, both at the same depth, toes near-forward, no T stance, no catwalk posing, no forward head, no hunching, no rigid mannequin.
Exact costume continuity: open knee-length taupe tailored coat with the portrait's fine delicate woven jacquard material, authentic lapels, scale-appropriate microdetail not bold ornament; the portrait's dusty blue-gray scoop-neck sleeveless camisole extends into a fitted-waist gently A-line midi DRESS reaching lower midcalf. Fine vertical knitted ribbing visible on dress from neckline through skirt with realistic drape. Taupe fitted ankle boots with modest block heels. Same long side-parted ash-blonde hair cascading over left side of chest and past chest, same tiny stud earrings.
Soft broad neutral studio illumination exactly like the portrait, beautiful sculptural shading with crisp fine hair, eyelash, lip, cloth and seam details. Neutral color balance. Full figure occupies almost the entire height with modest white margin. Portrait 2:3 canvas. Highest available native detail. No text, labels, panels or extra people. This is the approved portrait at a wider framing with physically coherent body, NOT a restyle.
